Usage: coverageratchet <command>

Per-file coverage enforcement that only goes up

Commands:
  ratchet [config] Tighten thresholds to match current coverage (default) (default)
  check [config]   Check coverage against thresholds (exits non-zero if any file fails)
  loosen [config]  Set thresholds down to current coverage (makes check pass immediately)
  check-json [config] [output] Write per-file coverage results as JSON for CI artifact upload
  baseline-lines [config] Record current covered-line counts as per-file floors (bootstrap and re-baseline)
  targets [config] List files sorted by coverage to find improvement targets
  gaps [config]    List uncovered branch points per file
  loosen-from-ci [config] Pull CI coverage results into local platform-specific thresholds
  merge <baseline> <partial> <output> Merge two Cobertura files by taking max hits per line
  refresh-baseline Copy each coverage.cobertura.xml to coverage.baseline.xml in the search dir

Global flags (can appear anywhere):
  --search-dir <path>   directory to scan for coverage.cobertura.xml
                        (default: current directory; recursive)
  --merge-baselines     before reading coverage, merge each
                        coverage.cobertura.xml onto its sibling
                        coverage.baseline.xml (max hits per line) so
                        partial test runs cannot lower the ratchet.
                        Bootstraps a baseline on first use.

Config file format (default: coverage-ratchet.json):
  {
    "overrides": {
      "Program.fs": {
        "line": 85.5,
        "branch": 77.0,
        "reason": "CLI entry point — exit calls are not coverable"
      },
      "Os.fs": [
        { "line": 79, "branch": 76, "platform": "macos" },
        { "line": 46, "branch": 44, "platform": "linux" }
      ]
    },
    "countFloors": {
      "Program.fs": { "coveredLines": 383, "coveredBranches": 41 }
    }
  }

  - "overrides" holds PERCENTAGE floors. Files not listed must have 100%
    line and 100% branch coverage.
  - "countF

result.stdout:
Usage: coverageratchet check [config]

Check coverage against thresholds (exits non-zero if any file fails)

Arguments:
  [config]           Path to the JSON config file (default: coverage-ratchet.json)

Exit 0 = every configured floor was measured, and every F# file in the
         report met its line+branch threshold.
Exit 1 = at least one MEASURED file fell below a floor.
Exit 2 = this run cannot answer the question. Either the report holds
         no F# file at all, or [config] records a floor for a file that
         has no row in the report — so that floor was never checked.
         Neither is a pass, and both used to be reported as one.

The expected set comes from [config], never from the report. A report
that shrinks used to shrink the claim with it: "7/7 files passed" reads
the same whether 7 files exist or 50 do.

Use in CI. Files not listed in [config] must hit 100%/100%.

result.stdout:
Usage: coverageratchet loosen [config]

Set thresholds down to current coverage (makes check pass immediately)

Arguments:
  [config]           Path to the JSON config file (default: coverage-ratchet.json)

Lower thresholds in [config] to match current coverage so 'check'
passes. Use sparingly — bootstrapping, or after a deliberate drop.
Unlike 'ratchet' this can move thresholds DOWN.

Applies to PERCENTAGE floors only. The covered-line count floors live
in the separate "countFloors" section; re-baseline those with
'baseline-lines'.

result.stdout:
Usage: coverageratchet gaps [config]

List uncovered branch points per file

Arguments:
  [config]           Path to the JSON config file (default: coverage-ratchet.json)

For each file with branches < 100%, prints the source lines where
uncovered branches sit. Use to plan tests for partial branch
coverage.
